purpose: second independent synthesizer (GridSynth) actual T-count vs pyLIQTR rz_decomp actual T-count vs built-in model estimate, on the frozen 100-angle set
note: descriptive comparison only; no calibration constant is refit against these outputs. rz_decomp and GridSynth counts are paired in the same process on identical angle values; per-angle rz counts may move by +/-2 T across runs near a grid cell boundary due to floating tail and gmpy2 precision context, while the distribution mean is stable (<0.3% vs frozen c_microbenchmark_100.json); inference therefore uses paired MAE/RMSE/MAPE and distribution means, not exact per-angle reproducibility.
